items.title: FINAL: Lakers 121, Pistons 116. Trailed by 26 early in the 2nd, couldn't rally back. Jenkins (31 points, 8 made 3-pointers) and Huerter (22 points, 5 assists, 5 blocks and 2 steals) were bright spots.
items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
FINAL: Lakers 121, Pistons 116. Trailed by 26 early in the 2nd, couldn't rally back. Jenkins (31 points, 8 made 3-pointers) and Huerter (22 points, 5 assists, 5 blocks and 2 steals) were bright spots. 

Awful night from the starters and Cade (14 points, 8 assts, 6-15 overall).
